title: Add RAG agent examples, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Priya Patel
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; updated docs site navigation and example snapshots; included a basic end-to-end integration example for agent tool calls.
description: Context: We want to make it easier for developers to get started with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agents and tool-calling patterns using Redwood. This PR adds a set of curated RAG templates, two end-to-end agent examples demonstrating tool calling (search and a small external API), and the corresponding quickstart docs that the docs site can ingest. Motivation: reduce time-to-first-success for users building agents, provide canonical examples for tool-calling patterns, and surface recommended prompt/metadata shapes for RAG. What this PR does: - Adds `examples/rag/templates` with 3 opinionated templates (faq-style, extractive-summarize, multi-tool-orchestrator). - Adds `examples/rag/agents/tool-calling/` with two runnable examples: `search-agent` (calls local vector search) and `weather-agent` (demonstrates safe external API calling + retries). - Adds quickstart docs under `examples/docs/quickstarts/rag-agent.md` including step-by-step setup, required config (env vars, vector store notes), and sample requests. - Updates `examples/docs/_sidebar.yml` and adds a small diagram `static/img/rag-agent-flow.png` used by the quickstart. - Adds test harnesses and CI e2e smoke test config for the examples. Checklist: - [x] Templates committed - [x] Examples implemented and smoke-tested locally - [x] Quickstart drafted and added to docs folder - [x] CI e2e smoke test added - [x] Review feedback addressed Known limitations: the examples use a lightweight in-memory vector store for portability — we call this out in the docs with guidance for production stores (FAISS/Redis). Follow-ups: a) ENG-8421 will track adding a TypeScript SDK example parity, b) add automated screenshots to the docs pipeline (PM-1198).
commits_summary: 5 commits: initial templates and agent scaffolding; add weather-agent tool-calling implementation; add search-agent and example data; docs quickstart and sidebar updates; CI smoke test and lint fixes after review.
